itemListElement.name: Best AI Meeting Summarizer Tools in the US for 2026

mainEntity.name: Can AI summarize a Teams meeting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Microsoft Teams can summarize meetings with Copilot, which requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Third-party tools such as Lynkk, Fathom, Fireflies, Otter and Read AI can also summarize Teams meetings.

mainEntity.name: Is there a free AI meeting summarizer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Fathom summarizes unlimited calls for free. Otter, Read AI and Lynkk also have free plans with monthly limits on minutes or meetings.

mainEntity.name: Where do I find the AI summary in Zoom?

acceptedAnswer.text: When AI Companion's meeting summary is turned on, Zoom emails the summary to the host after the meeting and keeps it in the host's Zoom account. The host can share it with participants.

mainEntity.name: Does Google Meet summarize meetings automatically?

acceptedAnswer.text: Google Meet can summarize meetings with Take notes for me if your Workspace edition or Google AI plan includes it. Someone must turn it on for each meeting, or the organizer can enable it from the calendar event.

mainEntity.name: How long does an AI meeting summary take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most AI summarizers deliver a summary within a few minutes after the meeting ends. Longer meetings and video recordings can take a little longer to process.

mainEntity.name: Can AI summarize meetings in Hindi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some tools can. Lynkk supports Hindi and a Hinglish setting for mixed Hindi and English.
